protocol.cpu: Single-threaded optimized C++ via ctypes, preallocated scratch/output, compact host u8 inputs, returned bytes and exact equality checked every request; no memoization
protocol.nvdec_preencoded: Warm live pipeline, frozen prepared access units; fresh input picture uploads still decoded each request; exact returned I420 checked
protocol.nvdec_native: Same warm path, native I_PCM serialization of compact host inputs, existing Writer limits plus exact prefix equality checked; host image inputs and host result
protocol.batch: Finite 64-job batch, no completion fences; input assembly/file I/O, process/startup, decode, selected readback, equality and EOS/shutdown included; prepared-input and native-host variants
protocol.warm: Context setup/reusable scratch, one full warmup and final close excluded from warm timings; per-request allocations remain timed; decoder lifecycle phases recorded separately
protocol.cpu_accounting: Parent process CPU plus live worker process CPU clock; finite batches use reaped child CPU. Includes all threads in those processes. Excludes other processes, IRQs and kernel workqueues; not energy
protocol.inputs: Prepared changing scenes/noise/extremes cycled in order (fixtures_per_case records count); warm cache behavior, fixed motion fields. Chains retain intermediates; only final result copied
protocol.limits: Implementation comparison on one host, not isolated hardware throughput. CPU single-threaded, no hand-written SIMD; -O3 compiler vectorization. No universal claim or energy/power measurement
